summary: GigaMedia filed a 6-K reporting its subscription of 719.09 million Aeolus Series C Preferred Shares via conversion and settlement of convertible promissory notes totaling US$12.37 million principal. The subscription price was ~US$0.0176 per share. Post-transaction, GigaMedia holds 719.83 million shares with 33.35% voting rights, changing the accounting from available-for-sale to equity method. This is a routine investment conversion and not a special situation; no public tender, third-party acquisition or strategic restructuring is involved. What to watch: potential future transactions in Aeolus securities.
